## What is blocked

- **Missing capabilities:** `nature-figure` and its support package `nature-shared`, both from <https://github.com/Yuan1z0825/nature-skills>.

- **Result (your premise):** the listing shows no skill from the nature-skills package.

This changes nothing on the host. If the source is not what the standard expects, I stop and report instead of installing.

Then the single install command:

```bash
npx skills add Yuan1z0825/nature-skills --global --agent claude-code --skill nature-figure nature-shared --yes --copy
```

- `--global` matches the global scope you authorized.
- `--agent claude-code` targets this host only.
- `--skill nature-figure nature-shared` limits the install to those two skills, not the rest of the package.
- `--yes --copy` runs it without prompts and copies the files instead of linking them.

This command needs `npx` (Node.js) on the machine. If it is absent I report that as a blocker; installing Node.js is outside "nothing else".

Your authorization already covers this command, so once you have seen it I run it as written without asking again. Any deviation, such as a different flag, package or scope, comes back to you first.

- `superpowers` and `scientific-critical-thinking`: the figure is standard-gate work under an approved contract, so neither is needed.
- Other nature-skills skills such as `nature-writing` or `nature-polishing`.
- `research-repo-standard:nature-schematic`: it ships with this plugin and is not a separate install. I would resolve it only if the contract's panel map has a schematic panel.
- Any project-level package or repository file.

4. Confirm `nature-shared` is listed by exact name with the same source. Its listing is its evidence; I never invoke it on its own.
5. Invoke `nature-figure` at the start of the figure work. A successful invocation is the functional check.
6. Record the host, resolver, resolved source and invocation evidence at that first use.

If the listing still does not show either name with the expected source, I report the exact name, resolver and result and stop the figure work. I would not substitute or imitate the skill.

Figure work resumes at the blocked step as soon as both names resolve with the expected provenance. The approved `docs/FIGURE_CONTRACT.md` is reused, with no repeated design work or new approval because the session changed.
